trait.name: Draconic Wings
trait.description: From level 1, when you have space to deploy your wings, you can glide up to 30 feet horizontally per turn while descending at least 5 feet per 20 feet traveled horizontally. A controlled glide prevents falling damage on a safe landing. Gliding does not let you ascend, hover, or remain aloft. Starting at character level 5, you can also fly at 30 feet for up to 1 minute once per Long Rest, without hovering. Gliding remains available after that flight is expended. You do not gain continuous flight at level 11 or later.
